title: VP defense pressed on P319M China remittances, P4.4B transactions
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment trial defense lawyers of Vice President Sara Duterte have stressed “relatively smaller personal expenses” that she and her husband had incurred rather than…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The impeachment trial defense lawyers of Vice President Sara Duterte have stressed “relatively smaller personal expenses” that she and her husband had incurred rather than address “bigger issues” — such as the alleged P319.33 million in remittances from China, including Hong Kong, and P4.4 billion in transactions they had from 2007 to 2025.
